answer: Audits are published in lotus, queued in summit, and echo publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 32 identities per epoch. A farm of 137 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4389 identities would post 1753 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
